detail.longDescription: So, I've been messing around with AI/LLM stuff since about February. It's become a big part of how I maintain my # homelab and how I build # selfhosted software. It's also about to become a huge part of my job. I'd like to actually talk about it publicly, but I know a lot of people frown on that stuff around here and I want to respect that without having to CW every post. I'm considering spinning up an alt specifically for those kinds of things. I won't be boosting across accounts, except maybe for the very first one. Is that something that y'all would be interested in? If not that's completely fine, but please hold the vitriol.
